messages.subject: Stratton MSA — renewal diary note
messages.plaintextBody:
James — unrelated to Harborlight, but the Caspian / Stratton Energy MSA comes up for its first renewal review in the spring. Worth a diary note to check the uplift mechanism and the change-control schedule before then. I'll add it to the Caspian client folder.

Elena
